visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, dark wavy hair wearing a white textured sweater stands against a dark gray wall decorated with white linear geometric patterns. She looks directly at the camera, gesturing with both hands pointed upward as she speaks. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial expressions and upper body. (2) A close-up shot features a hand holding an orange square plastic building plate with multiple circular pegs on its surface. In the background, a box labeled 'MAGBLOX' is visible on a light-colored wooden surface, indicating a product-focused transition. (3) The scene shifts to a bright indoor living room where a woman and a toddler sit on the floor. They are surrounded by various colorful toys and transparent magnetic building structures. The woman is wearing glasses and smiles while interacting with the child and the building blocks. (4) Hands are seen opening a cardboard box filled with neatly stacked, vibrant magnetic tiles in colors like red, yellow, blue, and green. The focus is on the variety and packaging of the items. (5) A toddler in a cream-colored outfit plays with a complex structure made of clear magnetic tiles on a wooden table. A hand assists the child in attaching a clear plastic tube, part of a 'marble run' set, to the structure. (6) Returning to the initial setting, the woman in the white sweater continues her address to the camera, using hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background remains the dark wall with white lines. (7) A montage follows showing the toddler and the woman building various structures. Close-ups highlight the mechanical connection of tubes snapping into magnetic tiles. Animated colorful bird and owl graphics appear temporarily on screen. (8) In a dimly lit scene, a phone flashlight is used to illuminate a large, glowing polyhedral structure built from colorful magnetic tiles, creating a kaleidoscope effect on the floor. The toddler watches with curiosity. (9) The woman demonstrates the compatibility of the magnetic tiles with standard plastic bricks (Lego style). Hands are shown snapping thick green and yellow bricks onto a magnetic baseplate on a green tray. (10) The woman appears again in the final shot, smiling and pointing toward the viewer as she concludes her presentation in the same indoor setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a friendly, enthusiastic, and clear tone over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar background track. The tempo is upbeat, creating a warm, domestic atmosphere. (2) A short, bright 'pop' sound effect occurs as the scene changes visually, followed by a male voice interjecting a brief comment in a supportive, slightly humorous tone. The background music remains constant. (3) Continuous female narration follows, describing product features. The sound of plastic magnetic tiles clicking together ('clack-clack') is audible at intervals, synchronized with building actions. (4) A whimsical cartoon 'boing' sound effect accompanies a male interjection, adding a lighthearted, comedic touch to the segment. (5) The female narrator's speech becomes more instructional, maintaining a professional yet accessible quality. The sound design includes the gentle rattling of plastic parts and the rhythmic background music which subtly builds in volume toward the end. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's enthusiastic closing remarks, followed by a final musical flourish that fades out smoothly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an endorsement and product review for 'MAGBLOX' magnetic building tiles, highlighting their design, durability, and multi-functional use (including light effects and Lego compatibility) to appeal to parents looking for engaging educational toys.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The narrator explicitly mentions a 'group buy' (團購), demonstrates the product's specific benefits, and highly recommends it to parents.
